import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

np.random.seed(42)

# Paths
input_dir = "./input"
output_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv"))

target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"

# Identify feature columns
features_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]

# Convert categorical features - Wilderness_Area columns need categorical treatment
# Based on Forest dataset, Wilderness_Area1-Area4 are categorical (low cardinality)
categorical_features = []
for cat_name in ["Wilderness_Area", f"Wilderness_Area{i}" for i in range(1, 5)]:
    if cat_name in features_cols:
        categorical_features.append(cat_name)

# Prepare features
X_train_full = train_df[features_cols].copy()
y_train_full = train_df[target_col].values
test_ids = test_df[id_col].values.values
X_test = test_df[features_cols].copy()

# Stratified train/val split to avoid single-member class errors
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Train LightGBM with optimized parameters for speed and accuracy
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=150,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=50,
    max_depth=6,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=True,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50)])

# Evaluate on true hold-out validation set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_predictions)

print(f"Validation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file using sample submission template format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": test_predictions})
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)
